author: GoPro
description:
Experience every stair drop, tight corner, and full-speed sprint through the streets of Italy with GoPro Athlete @FelipeAgurto's POV from @redbull's Genova Cerro Abajo 2026, captured on his GoPro HERO13 Black Ultra Wide Edition.

For the third consecutive year, La Superba hosted one of the world's most spectacular urban downhill mountain bike races. Riders tackled a demanding 1.4 mile course that dropped 915 feet from Monte Peralto to Largo della Zecca, charging through ancient staircases, narrow medieval alleyways, high-speed straights, and technical hairpin turns.

The 2026 edition brought the world's fastest and most fearless downhill riders to Genova to push the limits on one of the most iconic city courses in mountain biking. Watch Felipe Agurto navigate centuries-old architecture, natural obstacles, and demanding features.

For more MTB 👉 @GoProBike
